title: Indigo Revolt
subtitle: Peasant resistance to coercive indigo cultivation.
summary: The Indigo Revolt mobilized peasants in Bengal against exploitative planter systems, combining local resistance, legal contestation, and public debate in colonial society.
heroTagline: Peasant resistance to coercive indigo cultivation.
whyItMatters: It became a landmark in agrarian protest history and shaped later anti-colonial political language around rights and exploitation.
